user.title: Add a sea location
user.description: How would you like to choose the location?

menu_options.search: Search for a beach or place by name
menu_options.map: Pick a point on the map

search.title: Search
search.description: Enter a beach or place name, e.g. "Bournemouth beach".

map.title: Pick a point
map.description: Place the pin in the sea or on the shore. The nearest sea grid point will be used.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the service. Try again shortly.
error.no_results: No places found. Try a different name.
error.no_sea_data: No sea data is available for this point. Is it inland?
error.too_far_from_sea: This point is too far from the sea. Choose a coastal location.

init.title: Measured buoy data (optional)
init.description: Use real readings from the nearest Regional Coastal Monitoring buoy instead of the model when one is close enough. Needs a free API key from coastalmonitoring.org (see the README). Leave the key blank to turn this off.

data.cco_domain: Domain the key was issued for

data_description.cco_domain: The domain you gave when you requested the key, e.g. example.org

error.invalid_auth: The key or domain was rejected. Check both match what you registered.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the buoy service. Try again shortly.
error.domain_required: Enter the domain the key was issued for.
